extracted.name: Chocolate Cookies
extracted.description: A chocolate cookie is a drop cookie that originated in the United States and features chocolate as its main flavour. Do try this recipe and write your reviews in the comments.
instruction_lines: In a bowl whisk together the egg, milk, sugar and butter.
Now a separate bowl mix the rest of the ingredients except for the chocolate chips.
Now add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients to make a dough. Add chocolate chips to the dough.
Now shape the cookies as desired. Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes. Serve and Enjoy.
